title: question 9
text: question 9 Ove and Rune had a silly fight over which model of car they drove. The fight lasted for years. In what ways do you think Rune and Ove resembled each other? question 10 Parwaneh showed up out of the blue as Ove’s neighbor and began to pester him to do things. How much of it was because of her exuberant nature and how much because she realized the truth of Ove’s life and wanted to help him?
